shadows.name: spot-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus glow on cards and primary controls.

shadows.name: champion-aura
shadows.purpose: Platinum-toned glow, Hall of Fame 1st place only.

motion.name: vote-heart-pop
motion.purpose: The one authored micro-moment on voting.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: PlayStation-blue CTA; the only lit control in a dark room.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, hsl(210 100% 56%)); color: hsl(210 40% 98%); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 0 32px -8px hsl(210 100% 56% / 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, hsl(210 100% 56%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Vote Pill
components.description: Heart vote control; red only when voted; scale-pop on press.
components.css: .ds-vote { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(215 20% 65%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-vote:hover { color: #ef4444; } .ds-vote.voted { color: #ef4444; } .ds-vote.voted svg { fill: #ef4444; } .ds-vote:active svg { animation: ds-vote-pop 0.5s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-vote-pop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.5); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Exhibit Card
components.description: Gallery card: flush native-ratio image over a dark plaque of metadata.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card, hsl(224 71% 8%)); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 32px -8px hsl(210 100% 56% / 0.45); } .ds-card-img { aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: linear-gradient(160deg, hsl(222 40% 18%), hsl(224 60% 9%)); } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px; color: hsl(210 40% 98%); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Champion Plaque
components.description: Reserved platinum treatment for the monthly #1.
components.css: .ds-plaque { background: linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(224 71% 10%), hsl(224 71% 7%)); border: 1px solid hsl(210 25% 88% / 0.25); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 0 48px -12px hsl(210 25% 88% / 0.35); } .ds-plaque-kicker { color: hsl(215 18% 62%); font: 600 0.75rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-plaque-name { margin-top: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(210 30% 94%), hsl(215 18% 72%)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; font: 900 1.5rem/1.2 Outfit, sans-serif; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Sticky blurred midnight bar; active route gets a slate fill.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: hsl(224 71% 4% / 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(217 33% 17%); font: 500 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; color: hsl(210 40% 98%); } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: hsl(217 33% 17%); } .ds-nav a.active { background: hsl(217 33% 17%); } .ds-nav-cta { margin-left: auto; background: hsl(210 100% 56%); color: white; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: The gallery is dark and quiet; the only light falls on the exhibits — the platinum screenshots themselves. Every surface decision serves one idea: a captured platinum is a museum object. The chrome recedes into deep navy and cool gray, and attention is bought with contrast and spotlight, never with decoration. The identity material is platinum: a cool silver-white used almost nowhere, so that when it appears it reads as the trophy metal it evokes.
keyCharacteristics: Screenshots shown at native aspect ratio; never force-cropped.
Flat at rest; scenic blue glow only on hover/focus/celebration.
Platinum metal reserved for championship moments (≤5% of a screen).
Outfit heavy display as the voice; Inter for operations.
Dark-first: the .dark token set is canonical.

rules.name: The Platinum Reserve Rule
rules.body: Platinum metal may only appear on championship content: the monthly #1, Hall of Fame placements, and Pride of the Collection. If a surface has no champion, it shows no metal.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Blue glow marks state (hover, focus, celebration), never idle decoration. A resting card emits no light.

rules.name: The Vote Is a Number Rule
rules.body: Vote counts render in the label tier with tabular-nums; they are data, never display type.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Glow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, championship).

dos: Do show screenshots at native aspect ratio; the crop of a trophy list is the content.
Do keep idle surfaces flat and let hover glow carry life.
Do reserve platinum for championship moments; its rarity is its value.
Do tint secondary text on colored grounds from the ground's hue, never gray.
Do use tabular numerals wherever counts change (votes, rankings).
donts: Don't use gradient text outside the platinum plaque treatment.
Don't let red or green wander off their reserved jobs (vote, success/error).
Don't force 16:9 object-cover crops on user screenshots in Explore or profiles.
Don't stack a border and a big soft shadow on the same card (ghost card).
